subject: Context capacity + $/1M token target — follow-up & action items
messages:
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.ai>
To: Olivia Chen <olivia@acme.ai>, Samir Patel <samir.p@acme.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Sun, 9 Aug 2026 14:05:00 -0700
Subject: Context capacity + $/1M token target — follow-up & action items

Hi Olivia / Samir,

Thanks again for taking time today. Quick recap from our discovery call and a few asks so we can build a concise pricing sketch for your procurement team. High-level notes: 

- Primary use case: product search + answer generation for catalog + conversational customer support.
- Expected monthly active queries: 1.2M user queries (search), 150k conversational sessions.
- Typical conversational interaction: 2 prompts + 1 completion (average).
- Latency target: 95th <= 500ms for search queries.

Key unknowns we need to finalize pricing estimates:
1) Average prompt tokens and completion tokens per request (per query / per session). Example: prompt 250 tokens + completion 180 tokens.
2) Context length distribution: percent of queries that need 8k vs 32k vs 128k context windows (search + full catalog context / multi-document synth).
3) Monthly budget range or target $/1M tokens you’re comfortable with — helps us recommend model families and quantization profiles.

Action items for Acme:
- Olivia: can you share a small sample (10–20) of representative prompts and typical completions (redact PII) — we can run token profiling. Attach as plain .txt is fine.
- Samir: confirm whether procurement has a firm target for $/1M tokens or a monthly spend band ($5k–$20k, $20k–$75k, etc.).

Planned next steps from Redwood:
- We’ll run an initial token audit on your sample, produce an expected token mix, and suggest two pricing envelope options (latency-optimised, cost-optimised).
- Provide an initial cost estimate and recommended context sizing (e.g., majority 8k with a subset of 32k instances) + suggested rollout plan.

I’ve attached a short template (sample_prompts_and_completions.txt) you can paste into. If you prefer, drop the samples into the Drive link and I’ll fetch them.

Best,
Karthik
Director, Strategic Accounts
Redwood Inference
---
Attachment stubs: sample_prompts_and_completions.txt (text), pricing_model_v2.xlsx (spreadsheet)

From: Olivia Chen <olivia@acme.ai>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.ai>
Cc: Samir Patel <samir.p@acme.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 10 Aug 2026 09:18:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Context capacity + $/1M token target — follow-up & action items

Hi Karthik — thanks for the clear summary. Per your asks, quick answers below and I attached a 15-sample set as requested.

Token/profile answers (ballpark):
- Search queries (1.2M/mo): average prompt tokens 120 (query + user history snippet), completion tokens 35 (top-k reranked snippet). Estimated 92% of these fit comfortably within 8k context.
- Conversational sessions (150k sessions/mo): average prompt tokens 420 (system + history + user), average completion tokens 220. For convo use, ~60% fit in 8k, ~35% benefit from 32k (multi-turn with embedded product history), ~5% might need 128k for extended troubleshooting threads / order histories.
- Nightly batch generation (internal reporting): 200k batched items per month, each with prompt 600 tokens and completion 300 tokens — these can be cost-optimized with larger batch sizes and lower latency SLO.

Budget: procurement is aiming for a target of ~ $1,200 per 1M tokens as an initial guide, with flexibility up to $2,000/1M for latency-sensitive workloads. They gave a rough monthly budget band of $25k–$60k while pilot'ing.

Notes:
- We redacted user identifiers in the sample. One attachment is a short doc with a long support thread example that shows an extended context (that’s likely the 128k case).
- Procurement would like a 90-day pilot estimate and a recommended starting configuration (context mix + model family) to take to their infra and compliance review.

Thanks — Olivia
VP Product, Acme Retail
---
Attachment: acme_sample_prompts_15.txt

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.ai>
To: Olivia Chen <olivia@acme.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Sales Ops <sales_ops@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 11 Aug 2026 09:20:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Context capacity + $/1M token target — follow-up & action items

Olivia / Samir — great, this is exactly what we need. Quick readout and proposed immediate next steps: 

Readout (based on your samples + our profiling):
- Token mix (monthly estimate):
  - Search queries: 1.2M x (prompt 120 + completion 35) = ~186M tokens/mo
  - Conversations: 150k sessions x (prompt 420 + completion 220) = ~93M tokens/mo
  - Batch reports: 200k x (prompt 600 + completion 300) = ~180M tokens/mo
  - Total estimated: ~459M tokens/mo (~5.5B tokens over 90 days).

- Context sizing:
  - Recommend baseline: serve search + most convs on 8k context model to hit latency targets and minimize cost (~85% of traffic).
  - Provision a pool of 32k-capacity instances (burstable) for ~35% of convs that need longer context; enable automatic fallback to 8k variants for cost control.
  - Reserve an on-demand 128k instance group for heavy support threads (pre-warm for scheduled windows).

- Cost sensitivity and model recommendation:
  - Given your procurement target of $1.2k/1M tokens, we show two envelopes:
    * Cost-optimised: Mixed quantized M-family with aggressive batching for batch jobs; estimated $950–$1,150 / 1M tokens (satisfies the lower bound).
    * Latency-optimised: S-family low-latency variants with smaller batch windows; estimated $1,600–$2,000 / 1M tokens (meets latency requirement for search).

Immediate next steps (actionable):
1) Redwood will send a 90-day pilot quote and a small configuration workbook showing expected monthly spend across the mixes (attached: redwood-context-cost-estimate-v1.pdf and pricing_model_v2.xlsx).
2) Marissa will coordinate an architecture review call with your infra team next Wed to discuss pre-warm/fallback behavior and KMS integration. Marissa — can you propose two times?
3) Olivia / Samir — confirm approval to run a 30-day token-audit (read-only) on a small subset of live traffic or we can use the samples for a modeled projection. Procurement sign-off needed for live audit.

I’ll also include a short appendix with assumptions and a sensitivity table for the $/1M token target so procurement can see the levers (batch size, quantization, context mix).

If this matches, I’ll mark the deal_stage in HubSpot as "pilot_negotiation" and draft the 90-day pricing in the workbook for your review.

Thanks — talk soon.
Karthik
Director, Strategic Accounts
Redwood Inference
---
Attachments sent: redwood-context-cost-estimate-v1.pdf, pricing_model_v2.xlsx
notes: HubSpot action: set deal stage to pilot_negotiation after Olivia confirms live audit.
Marissa to propose times for infra architecture call; include EVP of Security if procurement requests KMS details.
Follow-up deadline: 2026-08-13 for procurement decision on 30-day token audit approval.
